verdict.note: Accept all approval items. The switching record and acceptance definitions preserve the actual forall (j,omega) exists (S,label,T,tau) quantifier order without assuming uniform source choice. Generic complete acceptance and switching acceptance are equivalent; selected protocols are inherited from the generic collection, so distinct-protocol cost cannot increase. Empty paid markers correctly preserve the cost of a specified acquisition while contributing no source, and canonical optimization may delete them. The M=|Omega| record bound and B_sw encoding bound are finite and honestly allowed to be exponential. The headline optimizer and infeasibility result therefore cover general physical feasibility rather than a uniform-only subclass. On the ordinary image, the forward construction preserves cost, the reverse construction gives a weak per-certificate cost inequality after READ-mask coalescing, and the two inequalities correctly imply equality of feasibility and optimum costs. The former uniform optimizer remains explicitly restricted. No assumption strengthening or assume-the-crux narrowing is introduced.
